name: 97444 · Gold Beach, OR
findings: ZIP 97444 (Gold Beach) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97444 (Gold Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97444 (Gold Beach) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
